rationale.overall: B tracks the reference’s material split, contact lighting, and volumetric depth more closely while keeping the same macro read.
rationale.material: B’s textured-versus-smooth ground, glow spill onto the smooth plane, and shaded translucent loop better match the reference’s volumetric shading, translucency, and lighting than A’s denser mesh-everywhere treatment.
rationale.silhouette: Both preserve the same diagonal rounded slab plus upper-left curl against the split field, with no decisive shape difference.
rationale.smallsize: At 32px and 16px, B keeps a clearer orange under-glow and cleaner figure–ground blocks while the loop residue stays comparably faint in both.
